main_body: A round leafy bush/tree canopy seen from above-front, a single mass of mixed greens with three small brown branch stubs, no trunk or base.
top_band: none: the column is mixed light and dark green leaf clumps from row 2 to row 45, with no distinct top band and front face.
evidence: An organic leaf canopy: the column scan alternates between light (L~170) and dark (L~60-80) greens in 1-4 row runs, which reads as leaf clumps and not a top surface over a front face. It is a one-mass foliage blob, so the top/front contract is not structurally applicable. Organic kind, so it passes on this basis despite the missing top and front bands. A correct canopy is a rounded volume with light foliage on top and darker underside, and here the light and dark clumps are scattered evenly instead.

style.evidence: Median 101 colours per tile against 108 and 109 for the references, 0% flat fill, and 0% neutral dark edge pixels, so the outline is tinted dark teal-green and not black. The leaf clumps use about five greens from deep teal to bright lime and carry per-clump highlights, as the references do. The candidate has fewer distinct colours overall (203 against 427 and 567), but it is a smaller, single bush with no trunk, and the per-tile density is at reference level. The shading is a bit evenly scattered, with less volumetric light-to-dark modelling than the references, but the craft is acceptable next to them.
